hooks.command: f=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input", {}).get("file_path", ""))'); [ -n "$f" ] && { ruff format "$f" 2>/dev/null; ruff check --fix --silent "$f" 2>/dev/null; }; exit 0

f=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input", {}).get("file_path", ""))'); if echo "$f" | grep -qE '(\.coverage$|coverage\.xml$|htmlcov/)'; then echo 'Blocked: generated file - do not edit directly' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
